title: EVA class definitions and least-class admission
goal: EVA-00…03 as data in src/ with what each may touch, and admission that picks the least class a job needs and refuses a job asking above its grant
acceptance: EVA-00 no external effects, EVA-01 bounded, EVA-02 full grant, EVA-03 quarantine for untrusted input, defined as data with filesystem, network, credential and resource fields
Admission uses existing NERV grants and the T01 contract; it never adds an approval authority
Unit tests for least-class choice and refusal
privacy: Neutral repository-owned fixtures only; no credentials, model calls or external effects in tests.
validation: Plain TypeScript unit tests; npm test
escalation: New upstream API work belongs to its owning repository; NERV supplies adapters

effort.basis: Re-estimated 2026-11-14 from 0.25 h to 0.75 h: feature implementation steps closed since 2026-11-13 took 0.75–1 h (F-066-T01, F-066-T02, F-062-T03, F-044-T01) where the 0.25x pass had set 0.25–1 h; started from this step's estimate, not a ratio.
